diagnosis: The checks C3 and C4 passed because the lone decision-maker had access to PF1 and PF3, respectively, which provided the necessary context to make the correct decisions. Specifically, C3 passed due to the exact Saturday 23:59 certificate expiry (PF1) requiring a pressure-vessel inspection, and C4 passed due to the exact Sunday requirement for 1,200 units (PF3) necessitating commissioning Boiler 1 as backup steam capacity.

C3.why: The exact Saturday 23:59 certificate expiry changes the restart plan from ordinary maintenance to a required pressure-vessel inspection before Boiler 2 can operate again.

C4.why: The exact Sunday requirement for 1,200 units changes the contingency plan from leaving Boiler 1 idle to commissioning it as backup steam capacity for that production commitment.

fix_instructions: Tighten checks C3 and C4 to depend on PF1 and PF3, respectively. For C3, ensure it cannot be satisfied without the exact Saturday 23:59 certificate expiry. For C4, ensure it cannot be satisfied without the exact Sunday requirement for 1,200 units.
